# (one month per page; the date parameter selects it; geoname-id selects the city).
# Format: M/D|Weekday|start|end   — times are local, drik's own printing, rounded
# to the minute. An end earlier than its start wraps to the next day. Drik
# usually dates a window by the calendar day its start falls in; a handful of
# windows lying entirely between midnight and sunrise are instead dated by
# their HINDU day, so their printed times fall on the next civil date (their
# start anchors to a nakshatra boundary there, not on the printed date).
# The parity test consumes only the M/D column; weekday and times are context.
